caption: The drawing depicts a carved ornamental fragment rendered in shades of yellowish-brown and ochre, occupying the center of a plain, off-white background. The object is composed primarily of a curving, spiral motif on the left side, resembling a volute or scroll, with intricate leaf patterns and geometric detailing inside the swirl. To the right of the spiral, there are acorn-like forms and grouped rounded shapes in muted browns and reddish tones. The overall composition shows a section of a decorative architectural element, emphasizing the texture and three-dimensionality of the carving. Shadows and highlights are used to suggest depth and the natural wood material of the object.
title: Billethead from a Rockport Schooner
